title: multi-sdks: unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics and bump parity to v1.202.0
author: Avery Chen
description:
Motivation: bring Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs to parity for auth, retries, and streaming ergonomics and publish a coordinated release (v1.202.0). This PR consolidates behavioral differences observed across language SDKs, simplifies developer ergonomics for streaming APIs, and hardens retry/auth flows to match server-side expectations.

Summary of changes: consolidated token provider wiring so auth headers and refresh logic are consistent; introduced BackoffPolicy abstraction mirrored across all SDKs; standardized streaming iterator/callback APIs and added a small compatibility shim for older user code; unified default retryable error classes and excursion counts; bumped package versions to v1.202.0 and updated changelogs.

Checklist:
- [x] Python: auth refresh + backoff parity, streaming generator ergonomics
- [x] TypeScript: unify auth initialization, add unified RetryPolicy, streaming event emitter ergonomics
- [x] Go: retry middleware + context cancellation parity, streaming client ergonomics
- [x] E2E smoke tests for auth+retries across SDKs
- [x] CI passing across SDK matrix (linux/mac/windows where applicable)

High level rationale: teams running multi-language clients reported differing retry semantics (exponential vs linear defaults), inconsistent header refresh timing that caused rare 401 races, and ergonomics differences in streaming consumers that made porting code harder. Aligning behaviors reduces support surface and enables coordinated compatibility guarantees for our hosted and dedicated runtimes.

Notes on compatibility: most changes are backwards-compatible; streaming ergonomics introduce a small adapter layer and deprecate a legacy callback signature with a soft warning. See release notes for migration guidance.

Related: ENG-5142, ENG-5188, SUP-3321.

Liam O'Connor: Confirmed Go context cancellation semantics look good; requested an additional integration test covering mid-stream auth refresh.
Avery Chen: Added integration test (see commits) and pushed fix for a potential race in token_provider.go. CI reran and passed.
Sofia Martinez: Approved after verifying Python generator yields close properly on upstream EOF; minor doc suggestion applied.
release_notes:
- SDKs (Python/TS/Go): unify auth token refresh behavior and default retry policy to exponential backoff.
- Streaming APIs: improved ergonomics (generator/iterator + event emitter parity) and deprecation of legacy callback signature (soft warning).
- Bumped SDK package versions to v1.202.0; see migration guide in docs/sdk-migration/streaming-ergonomics.md
